description: The attributes of this element show the state of a load sensor.
A list of these elements is used in the execd.

attributes.name: name
description: Name of this load sensor, no hashing, we only have few loadsensors/host.
@todo what's the purpose of the name?

attributes.name: command
description: Absolute path of the load sensor script / binary.

attributes.name: pid
description: Pid of the load sensor process.

attributes.name: in
description: stdin filehandle to the loadsensor process (type FILE *)

attributes.name: out
description: stdout filehandle of the loadsensor process (type FILE *)

attributes.name: err
description: stderr filehandle of the loadsensor process (type FILE *)

attributes.name: has_to_restart
description: Do we have to restart the load sensor script?

attributes.name: tag
description: Tag for internal use (@todo 1 means it is running, 0 it isn't running? Verify.)

attributes.name: incomplete
description: Current values we got from the load sensor script.

attributes.name: complete
description: Last complete set of the load sensor's values.

attributes.name: last_mod
description: Last modification time of the load sensor script.
If the script is modified, then the load sensor will be re-started.
